From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Quick recap + proposed next steps (ML/Infra deep dive)

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and helpful context on Helio's inference constraints for clinical scoring. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can loop in the right folks on our side: 

- Key takeaways: (1) Production latency target: 120ms p50 for short-form scoring (<128 tokens); (2) data residency: US-only; (3) expected Q3 pilot throughput ~500 reqs/min with burst to 2k.
- Ask from Redwood: allow a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML/platform leads to validate throughput/latency assumptions and run through deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Proposed windows (we can pick one and lock attendee list):
- Tue May 4, 9:30–10:45 PT (75 min)
- Wed May 5, 13:00–14:15 PT (75 min)
- Thu May 6, 11:00–12:30 PT (90 min)

Agenda (draft, attached as rdw-proposed-tdx-agenda.md):
1) 10m — goals and constraints from Helio
2) 25–35m — ML infra walkthrough (model size, KV/cache, batching)
3) 20–30m — deployment options & perf profiles (latency/cost trade-offs)
4) 10m — next steps / action items

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side should attend (ML engineer + infra/platform contact ideal)? I’ve cc'd Marcus and Grace from Redwood — they’ll lead the deep dive.

Attachments: rdw-proposed-tdx-agenda.md (agenda stub), helio-psp-v2.pdf (notes from discovery call you shared)

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Monica — thanks for the concise recap. Helps a lot.

Tom and I are available for the May 5 window (Wed May 5, 13:00–14:15 PT). Our ML lead (Tom) will be on the call; I’ll also invite our Platform lead, Sarah Lopez, who manages region and KMS stuff. Can Sarah be included? Email: sarah.lopez@heliohealth.ai.

Two things to flag so you can prep:
- We use short-lived keys and rotate via HashiCorp Vault; if you can briefly surface how Private/VPC options integrate with KMS that would be helpful.
- We’d like to validate what OOM/eviction behavior looks like under sustained bursts — would you be able to share perf profiles for the model sizes we discussed?

Slot confirmed: Wed May 5, 13:00 PT. Please send calendar invite and any pre-read.
